narrative.details: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information for about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
narrative.objectives: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.
